'''Jeanette Shakalli''' is a [[Panamanians|Panamanian]] mathematician best known for her outreach activities in the Republic of Panama. She is currently Executive Director of the Panamanian Foundation for the Promotion of Mathematics (FUNDAPROMAT) a private non-profit foundation established to promote the study of mathematics in Panama.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://owsd.net/member/shakalli-jeanette|title=Shakalli Jeanette {{!}} OWSD|website=owsd.net|date=9 March 2020 |access-date=2020-03-27}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fundapromat.org/en/who-we-are/|title=About Us|website=Fundapromat|language=en-US|access-date=2020-04-02|archive-date=2020-09-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200922001037/https://www.fundapromat.org/en/who-we-are/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Education==

Shakalli earned a Bachelor of Science in Mathematics and Chemistry from the [[University of Notre Dame]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://issuu.com/universityofnotredamenewmedia/docs/panama_booklet__2_|title=University of Notre Dame - Panama|website=Issuu|language=en|access-date=2020-04-02}}</ref> In 2012, she received a Ph.D. in Mathematics from [[Texas A&M University]] under the advisement of [[Sarah Witherspoon|Sarah J. Witherspoon]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=164150|title=Jeanette Shakalli - The Mathematics Genealogy Project|website=www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu|access-date=2020-03-27}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://lathisms.org/october-12th-2019.html|title=October 12th 2019|website=lathisms.org|access-date=2020-03-27|archive-date=2020-03-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200322100811/http://www.lathisms.org/october-12th-2019.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Career ==
From 2012 to 2019 Shakalli worked for [[Secretaria Nacional de Ciencia y Tecnologia|National Secretariat of Science, Technology, and Innovation (SENACYT)]] of Panama.<ref>{{Cite book|last1=Haunsperger|first1=Deanna|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=zq6xDwAAQBAJ&q=Jeanette+Shakalli&pg=PA203|title=101 Careers in Mathematics: Fourth Edition|last2=Thompson|first2=Robert|date=2019-09-24|publisher=American Mathematical Soc.|isbn=978-1-4704-5085-4|language=en}}</ref> In 2016, she created the Program on Math Outreach in Panama which holds several activities a year on [[recreational mathematics]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://digitaleditions.walsworthprintgroup.com/article/Program+On+Math+Outreach+In+Panama/3345655/577524/article.html|title=Program On Math Outreach In Panama|website=digitaleditions.walsworthprintgroup.com|language=en-US|access-date=2020-03-27}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.senacyt.gob.pa/conferencista-internacional-presento-en-panama-la-conexion-existente-entre-la-gastronomia-y-las-matematicas/|title=Conferencista internacional presentó en Panamá la conexión existente entre la gastronomía y las matemáticas|last=Adames|first=Melissa|date=2019-10-12|website=Secretaría Nacional de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación|language=es|access-date=2020-03-27}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.senacyt.gob.pa/la-senacyt-organiza-conferencia-magistral-las-matematicas-detras-del-cubo-de-rubik/|title=La SENACYT organiza conferencia magistral "Las Matemáticas detrás del Cubo de Rubik"|date=2019-04-24|website=Secretaría Nacional de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación|language=es|access-date=2020-03-27}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.prensa.com/impresa/vivir/Divertidas-matematicas_0_4709529074.html|title=Divertidas matemáticas {{!}} La Prensa Panamá|date=2017-03-13|website=www.prensa.com|language=es|access-date=2020-03-27}}</ref> Since then she has organized over 50 mathematical outreach events in Panama.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://blogs.ams.org/livingproof/|title=Living Proof|last=Henrich|first=Allison|website=Living Proof|language=en-US|access-date=2020-04-02}}</ref>

She is chair of the Program Committee for [[Mathematical Association of America|Mathematics Association of America]]'s SIGMAA on Recreational Mathematics program. In 2017, she became the [[International Mathematical Union]]'s (IMU)  Committee for Women in Mathematics (CWM) Ambassador for Panama.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mathunion.org/cwm/about/cwm-ambassadors|title=CWM Ambassadors {{!}} International Mathematical Union (IMU)|website=www.mathunion.org|access-date=2020-04-02}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mathvalues.org/masterblog/math-ambassadors|title=MAA Math Ambassadors in a Global Mathematics Community|website=MATH VALUES|language=en-US|access-date=2020-04-02}}</ref> She is on the board of directors of both the [[Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers|IEEE]] Panama Section as secretary<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://r9.ieee.org/panama/quienes-somos/directivos/|title=Directivos - IEEE Sección Panamá|language=es|access-date=2020-04-02}}</ref> and the Panamanian Association for the Advancement of Science (APANAC) as admissions director.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.apanac.org.pa/es/actual-junta-directiva|title=Actual Junta Directiva {{!}} APANAC|website=www.apanac.org.pa|access-date=2020-04-02}}</ref>

==Honors==
In 2007, Shakalli was awarded the Senior GE Prize for Mathematics Majors at the University of Notre Dame which is given to one who excelled in mathematics in their senior year.<ref>{{Cite book|contribution=Awards and Prizes: Senior GE Prize for Mathematics Majors|page=104|url=http://scholarship.law.nd.edu/commencement_programs/7|title=
162nd University of Notre Dame Commencement and Mass Program
|publisher=University of Notre Dame|date=May 19, 2007|access-date=2025-05-10 }}</ref> Shakalli was recognized as [[Rotary International|Rotarian]] of the Year for 2018-2019 by the Rotary Club of Panama.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://clubrotariodepanama.com/es/category/actividades/|title=Actividades {{!}} Club Rotario de Panamá|language=es|access-date=2020-04-02}}</ref>
